title: Spinach-Feta Breakfast Tacos with Roasted Sweet Potato-Pepper Hash & Cucumber Sticks
components_from_title: Spinach-feta scrambled eggs in warm corn or flour tortillas
Roasted sweet potato and red pepper hash
summary: Breakfast-for-dinner tacos with soft scrambled eggs, wilted spinach, and feta, paired with crispy oven-roasted sweet potato and red pepper hash and cool cucumber sticks. Fully meat-free dairy dinner. About 35–40 minutes total and 25–30 minutes active.
ingredients: 3 cups baby spinach, washed and checked as appropriate
8–10 small kosher-certified pareve corn or flour tortillas
2 medium sweet potatoes (about 1½ lb), cut into ½-inch cubes
½ tsp smoked or sweet paprika
Optional: 1 avocado, sliced, and lime wedges
instructions: Heat oven to 425°F. Dice sweet potatoes into ½-inch cubes and red pepper into similar-size pieces. Toss with 1½ tbsp olive oil, paprika, cumin if using, and a little salt. Spread on a large baking sheet without crowding; roast 22–27 minutes, turning once, until sweet potatoes are fork-tender and browned at the edges.
While vegetables roast, cut cucumber into sticks. Whisk eggs with 2 tbsp water and a pinch of salt and pepper. Crumble feta.

Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-low heat. Add spinach and stir 1–2 minutes until wilted. Pour in beaten eggs; stir gently for 4–6 minutes until softly set but fully cooked. Remove from heat and fold in feta; taste before adding more salt.

Warm tortillas in a dry skillet, about 20–30 seconds per side, or wrap in foil and warm in the oven briefly. Fill with egg mixture and serve with roasted sweet potato-pepper hash and cucumber sticks. Optional avocado or lime for adults.
child_friendly_modifications: Offer plain scrambled eggs with a little feta on the side, a warm tortilla for rolling or dipping, sweet potato cubes without paprika, and peeled cucumber sticks. Chop spinach very finely or reserve some eggs before adding spinach. For the 3-year-old, serve bite-size pieces and avoid overfilling tacos. Let kids assemble their own tacos.
leftovers: Refrigerate within 2 hours; use cooked egg mixture and hash within 3–4 days. Reheat eggs until steaming hot and hash in a skillet or 375°F oven until hot; tortillas and cucumber are best kept separate. For next-day lunch, use extra hash in a quesadilla with kosher-certified cheese (dairy) or top with a freshly cooked egg.
